FROM: Site Security, Floor 3
TO: All Floor 3 personnel
RE: The teddy bear

Yes, we have all seen it. Yes, it waves. It is designated SCP-1048 and it is transferring through from Site-24 pending a containment review.

Do not give it materials. Do not accept its drawings as gifts. If it hugs your leg, file a contact report — it is friendly, and that is exactly what the review is about.

Update: the review is overdue because Site-24 has stopped answering queries about 1048. Their last transmission on the subject was a request for their staff roster 'as of before June'. Keep filing the contact reports.
